name: Rap Lab
description: The sandbox blueprint that turns bar-writing skill into code skill. Syllable counter, rhyme finder, verse analyzer — vanilla JS, phone-first, offline-capable.

the_pitch.for_the_brother: You already hear structure in bars — syllables, pockets, rhyme schemes. This lab shows you the code that does the same hearing. Same skill, new receipts.
the_pitch.for_the_client: Interactive promo pages for artists — their best bars, live on their fans' phones. $150 one-pager floor (PRICING.md).

files.index.html: The lab UI — bar input with live readout, verse analyzer, the learning card that maps every feature to its programming concept, and the rungs ladder.
files.audio-core.js: The whole engine in one readable file: RHYME_FAMILIES data, syllableCount(), lastWord(), findRhymes(), analyzeBar(), analyzeVerse(), UI wiring. Read it after using the lab — that's the design.
files.project-manifest.json: This file — the blueprint's ID card: what it is, who it's for, how to ship it, what it teaches.

tech.framework: none — vanilla only (ADR-001: if it can't run on a 2015 Android over USB tether, it doesn't ship)
tech.storage: localStorage (drafts stay on the device — SECURITY.md: nothing leaves without your say-so)
tech.offline: drops into any PWA shell — pair with core-system/manifest.json + service-worker.js pattern (wiki/Building/Turn-Website-Into-App.md)
tech.weight: under 20KB total — the 3-second rule on tethered 3G (ADR-002)

concepts_taught: data structures (RHYME_FAMILIES — a dictionary keyed by ending sound)
arrays + loops (a verse IS an array of bars; the report is one loop over it)
functions composing functions (analyzeBar = syllableCount + lastWord + findRhymes)
event handling + debouncing (the live readout waits 250ms so 3G thumbs aren't punished)

rung_1.what: Fork this lab, make it yours — change the colors, add one rhyme family of your own words, deploy on GitHub Pages.
rung_1.receipt: A merged PR on your own repo. 5 raffle tickets.

rung_2.what: Add a real feature — the punchline detector (flag words with double meanings), a bar randomizer, a share-card export.

rung_3.what: The artist promo hustle — 'I build interactive promo pages for your bars, $150 flat' — this lab is the portfolio piece in the pitch.
rung_3.receipt: Client work at the rate floors. The hustle becomes the income.

extend_it.data_grows: Add rhyme families to RHYME_FAMILIES in audio-core.js — every gap the lab reports is a contribution waiting to happen.
extend_it.next_tech: When rung 2 feels easy: save verses as JSON files (a repo of your bars, version-controlled — urban-dictionary/json_explained.md is the primer), then load them back. That's real app architecture.
extend_it.pair_with: fedpromptly-coach (drop the engine-connector.js tag in and the lab gains a Coach button) and prompts/project-generator/match_my_hobby_to_project.txt

block_rules_respected: Six Rules: no drama, no scams, real receipts, build each other up, the block stays free, protect the young brothers
Plain talk: every jargon term defined on first use, in the code comments AND the UI copy
Offline-first: works with zero connection after first load — the metered-data brother is a first-class user
